verdicts.reason: I'd pick A because it at least keeps a readable headline. 'Sunset Sessions' and 'Saturday 21 June' are legible and lead left to right. Its flaws: the description and venue copy is crammed into illegible micro-text on the right, the pills are jammed against the top edge, the logo is gone, and the RSVP CTA is shrunk to a tiny buried line. B has a clear CTA button on the right, but the headline, date, venue, description and pill labels are all too small to read at banner size. It is spread into four weak, scattered columns with no focal point, so it reads like a shrunk copy of the original rather than a rearranged one.
